note: Authoritative, version-matched notices for distributions whose sdist/wheel omit them. Each URL names an immutable commit; the tag-to-commit mapping is recorded as evidence.

sources.evidence: Each package's metadata names Repository https://github.com/pywinrt/pywinrt; git ls-remote refs/tags/v3.2.1 -> 21cbd0fd7ff91422ed76b4e3611d3fb52716e017 (2026-10-16).

excluded.reason: No license/notice text in its sdist or wheel and its declared repository is not public. It is only imported lazily by browser-harness when BROWSER_USE_API_KEY is set, with an ImportError fallback to local HTTP, so the redistributed core omits it.
